summary.text: Marshall Archer is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 129 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and social worker, he previously served as Deputy Mayor of Saco.

paragraphs.text: Archer served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2001 to 2005.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern Maine and a graduate degree from the University of New England.

Archer's career experience includes working as a social worker, as director of partner engagement for a workforce development organization, as a property investor and as a part-time faculty member at the University of Southern Maine.
He previously served as the City of Saco's Deputy Mayor and Ward 1 Councilor.
He took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
